description:
Predicted 3D structure of a gene's protein: its UniProtKB accession(s) (Ensembl Plants protein matches) and the
AlphaFold Protein Structure Database model for each, with mean pLDDT confidence and the fraction of residues in
each confidence band, plus viewer and file links. gene: symbol or Ensembl/IWGSC ID. Useful for judging whether a
coding variant or edit falls in a confidently folded domain. Cite AlphaFold DB (Varadi et al. 2024, Nucleic
Acids Res, doi:10.1093/nar/gkad1011) and UniProt.
name: protein_structure
